content: {"episode_id":"ep-05056","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"The patient presents with a history of recurrent syncope and palpitations, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other cardiac arrhythmias (I49.9, I48.91, R55). This service directly addresses the recurrent syncope and palpitations requiring extended monitoring to detect paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other cardiac arrhythmias."}
